descriptionChirho: The proper name Kish (קִישׁ), most notably the father of King Saul (1Sa 9:1,3; 10:11,21; 14:51; 2Sa 21:14; 1Chr 8:30,33; 9:36,39; 12:1; 26:28; Est 2:5; Acts 13:21), but also borne by other individuals including a Levite (1Chr 23:21-22; 24:29) and a Benjaminite (2Chr 29:12). All three clusters are the same name with different grammatical particles: bare form, with conjunction waw ('and Kish'), and with preposition lamed ('for/to Kish'). Spanish 'Quis/Kish,' Arabic 'قِيشَ/قَيْش,' Korean '기시/기스,' Swahili 'Kishi,' and Hindi 'कीश' consistently identify the same referent.
